# vendor/msf_gif — msf_gif (linked as C, not ported)

`msf_gif.h` copied verbatim from `/home/rajesh/opensource/graphics/raylib-6.2/examples/core/msf_gif.h`
(msf_gif v2.2 by Miles Fogle, as bundled with the raylib 6.2 examples).
MIT / public domain dual license — see the end of the header.

msf_gif is a third-party single-file GIF encoder, not part of raylib. Only the
`core_screen_recording` Zig-API example uses it: its C shim
(`examples/zig/core/core_screen_recording_shim.c`) instantiates the library.
